chunks.heading: Ponding Water
chunks.text: Poor drainage or structural settlement creates standing water. In Midland's heat, this accelerates membrane degradation and causes leaks within the ponding area.

chunks.heading: Hail Impact
chunks.text: Midland hail creates punctures, membrane bruising, and compromised waterproofing. Even small hail causes hidden damage that leads to leaks.

chunks.heading: Seam Failures
chunks.text: Seams are the weak point in any membrane system. Heat cycles, wind, and age cause seam separation—the most common source of flat roof leaks.

chunks.heading: Flashing Issues
chunks.text: Penetrations (HVAC units, vents, pipes) require proper flashing. These are common leak points when flashing cracks, separates, or was improperly installed.
